violations.text: The several floor tiles were observed to be cracked/chipped exposing the subfloor below and in need of replacement. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Per the Owner, plan in place for replacement of damaged floor tiles. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Plastic Utensils in the service window area were observed stored/displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Utensils were rearranged and stored properly at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/03/2024

The wall(s) and Ceiling in the dish area were observed to have an accumulation of soil residue/dust due to the wall mounted fan. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2024
